name: Favored Critical
body:
Your critical threats against your favored enemy automatically confirm

Prerequisite: Favored enemy class feature, Critical Focus

Benefit: Whenever you roll a critical threat against your favored enemy, it automatically confirms.

Special: You can gain this feat multiple times. Its effects do not stack. Each time you take this feat, it applies to a different favored enemy.
